"""A tiny game to build on. Change the numbers and see what happens."""

import pygame

from scene import Scene, Vehicle

# Things you can change
WIDTH = 640
HEIGHT = 480
PLAYER_SPEED = 5
PLAYER_SIZE = 40
BACKGROUND = (18, 22, 34)
PLAYER_COLOUR = (255, 165, 0)  # Orange for the fish
fish = pygame.Rect(300, 400, 50, 50)

pygame.init()
screen = pygame.display.set_mode((WIDTH, HEIGHT))
pygame.display.set_caption("My Game")
clock = pygame.time.Clock()

player = pygame.Rect(WIDTH // 2, HEIGHT // 2, PLAYER_SIZE, PLAYER_SIZE)

# The scene: everything the game shows, drawn back to front by scene.draw().
scene = Scene(screen)
scene.add("fish", Vehicle("orange"), size=(50, 50), at=(300, 400), layer="player")

running = True
while running:
    for event in pygame.event.get():
        if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
            running = False
        elif event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN and event.key == pygame.K_ESCAPE:
            running = False

    keys = pygame.key.get_pressed()
    if keys[pygame.K_LEFT]:
        player.x -= PLAYER_SPEED
    if keys[pygame.K_RIGHT]:
        player.x += PLAYER_SPEED
    if keys[pygame.K_UP]:
        player.y -= PLAYER_SPEED
    if keys[pygame.K_DOWN]:
        player.y += PLAYER_SPEED

    player.clamp_ip(screen.get_rect())

    scene.update()
    screen.fill(BACKGROUND)
    scene.draw()
    pygame.draw.rect(screen, PLAYER_COLOUR, player)
    pygame.display.flip()
    clock.tick(60)

pygame.quit()

"""A tiny game to build on. Change the numbers and see what happens."""

import pygame

from scene import Colour, Scene

# Things you can change
WIDTH = 640
HEIGHT = 480
PLAYER_SPEED = 5
PLAYER_SIZE = 40
BACKGROUND = (18, 22, 34)
PLAYER_COLOUR = (214, 142, 62)
SCORE_COLOUR = (240, 240, 240)
apple_color = (255, 0, 0)

pygame.init()
screen = pygame.display.set_mode((WIDTH, HEIGHT))
pygame.display.set_caption("My Game")
clock = pygame.time.Clock()

player = pygame.Rect(WIDTH // 2, HEIGHT // 2, PLAYER_SIZE, PLAYER_SIZE)

# The scene: everything the game shows, drawn back to front by scene.draw().
scene = Scene(screen)
apple = scene.add("apple", Colour("red", round=6),
                  size=(20, 20), at=(300, 300), layer="things")

score = 0
font = pygame.font.Font(None, 36)

running = True
while running:
    for event in pygame.event.get():
        if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
            running = False
        elif event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN and event.key == pygame.K_ESCAPE:
            running = False

    keys = pygame.key.get_pressed()
    if keys[pygame.K_LEFT]:
        player.x -= PLAYER_SPEED
    if keys[pygame.K_RIGHT]:
        player.x += PLAYER_SPEED
    if keys[pygame.K_UP]:
        player.y -= PLAYER_SPEED
    if keys[pygame.K_DOWN]:
        player.y += PLAYER_SPEED

    player.clamp_ip(screen.get_rect())

    scene.update()
    # Open Nest: touching apple scores a point.
    for apple in scene.touching(player, "apple"):
        score += 1
        apple.respawn()
    screen.fill(BACKGROUND)
    scene.draw()
    pygame.draw.rect(screen, PLAYER_COLOUR, player)
    screen.blit(font.render(f"Score: {score}", True, SCORE_COLOUR), (10, 10))
    pygame.display.flip()
    clock.tick(60)

pygame.quit()

"""A tiny game to build on. Change the numbers and see what happens."""

import pygame

from scene import Colour, Ground, Scene, Sky, Tree

# Things you can change
WIDTH = 640
HEIGHT = 480
PLAYER_SPEED = 5
PLAYER_SIZE = 40
BACKGROUND = (125, 195, 245)
PLAYER_COLOUR = (214, 142, 62)
SCORE_COLOUR = (240, 240, 240)
apple_color = (255, 0, 0)

pygame.init()
screen = pygame.display.set_mode((WIDTH, HEIGHT))
pygame.display.set_caption("My Game")
clock = pygame.time.Clock()

player = pygame.Rect(WIDTH // 2, HEIGHT // 2, PLAYER_SIZE, PLAYER_SIZE)

# The scene: everything the game shows, drawn back to front by scene.draw().
scene = Scene(screen)
sky = scene.add("sky", Sky(BACKGROUND), size=(640, 480), at=(0, 0), layer="background")
grass = scene.add("grass", Ground("green"), size=(640, 100), at=(0, 380), layer="scenery")
tree = scene.add("tree", Tree("green"),
                 size=(20, 40), at=(100, 400), on="grass", count=10, vary=0.25,
                 layer="scenery")
apple = scene.add("apple", Colour("red", round=6),
                  size=(20, 20), at=(300, 300), layer="things")
barn = scene.add("barn", Colour("red", round=6),
                 size=(100, 150), at=(500, 350), layer="things")

score = 0
font = pygame.font.Font(None, 36)

running = True
while running:
    for event in pygame.event.get():
        if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
            running = False
        elif event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN and event.key == pygame.K_ESCAPE:
            running = False

    keys = pygame.key.get_pressed()
    if keys[pygame.K_LEFT]:
        player.x -= PLAYER_SPEED
    if keys[pygame.K_RIGHT]:
        player.x += PLAYER_SPEED
    if keys[pygame.K_UP]:
        player.y -= PLAYER_SPEED
    if keys[pygame.K_DOWN]:
        player.y += PLAYER_SPEED

    player.clamp_ip(screen.get_rect())

    scene.update()
    # Open Nest: touching barn scores a point.
    for barn in scene.touching(player, "barn"):
        score += 1
        barn.respawn()
    # Open Nest: touching apple scores a point.
    for apple in scene.touching(player, "apple"):
        score += 1
        apple.respawn()
    screen.fill(BACKGROUND)
    scene.draw()
    pygame.draw.rect(screen, PLAYER_COLOUR, player)
    screen.blit(font.render(f"Score: {score}", True, SCORE_COLOUR), (10, 10))
    pygame.display.flip()
    clock.tick(60)

pygame.quit()

"""A tiny game to build on. Change the numbers and see what happens."""

import pygame

from scene import Cloud, Ground, Scene, Sky, Tree

# Things you can change
WIDTH = 640
HEIGHT = 480
PLAYER_SPEED = 5
PLAYER_SIZE = 40
BACKGROUND = (125, 195, 245)
PLAYER_COLOUR = (214, 142, 62)

pygame.init()
screen = pygame.display.set_mode((WIDTH, HEIGHT))
pygame.display.set_caption("My Game")
clock = pygame.time.Clock()

player = pygame.Rect(WIDTH // 2, HEIGHT // 2, PLAYER_SIZE, PLAYER_SIZE)

# The scene: everything the game shows, drawn back to front by scene.draw().
scene = Scene(screen)
sky = scene.add("sky", Sky(BACKGROUND), size=(640, 480), at=(0, 0), layer="background")
grass = scene.add("grass", Ground(), size=(640, 100), at=(0, 380), layer="scenery")
tree = scene.add("tree", Tree(), size=(50, 100), at=(250, 380), on="grass", layer="scenery")
cloud1 = scene.add("cloud1", Cloud(),
                   size=(100, 30), at=(100, 100), moves=(1, 0), layer="scenery")
cloud2 = scene.add("cloud2", Cloud(),
                   size=(120, 30), at=(300, 80), moves=(-1, 0), layer="scenery")

running = True
while running:
    for event in pygame.event.get():
        if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
            running = False
        elif event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN and event.key == pygame.K_ESCAPE:
            running = False

    keys = pygame.key.get_pressed()
    if keys[pygame.K_LEFT]:
        player.x -= PLAYER_SPEED
    if keys[pygame.K_RIGHT]:
        player.x += PLAYER_SPEED
    if keys[pygame.K_UP]:
        player.y -= PLAYER_SPEED
    if keys[pygame.K_DOWN]:
        player.y += PLAYER_SPEED

    player.clamp_ip(screen.get_rect())

    scene.update()
    screen.fill(BACKGROUND)
    scene.draw()
    pygame.draw.rect(screen, PLAYER_COLOUR, player)
    pygame.display.flip()
    clock.tick(60)

pygame.quit()
